exercises.name: 1-2-3 Clap
exercises.instructions: 1-2-3 knee, but lift knee high enough to be able to clap underneath
exercises.safetyCues: Modification: Stay grounded

exercises.name: 1-2-3 Knee
exercises.safetyCues: Modify: Step it out

exercises.name: Air Squat
exercises.safetyCues: Modification: reduce ROM

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.instructions: Small, controlled circles forward, then backward.
exercises.safetyCues: Keep your shoulders pulled down and back.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop to a plank, push-up, jump up.
exercises.safetyCues: Maintain core control during the jump back.

exercises.name: Butt Kicks
exercises.safetyCues: Modify: Keep one foot grounded, slight forward lean

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.safetyCues: Don't pull on your neck.

exercises.name: Double Butt Kicks
exercises.instructions: Hop twice on same leg, keep opposite leg bent, foot towards butt
exercises.safetyCues: Modification: Always keep one foot on ground

exercises.name: Double Lateral High Knee
exercises.instructions: Hop to side, lift knee, hop to side again, stay on one leg
exercises.safetyCues: Modification: Raise knee, step out, raise knee...

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.instructions: Keep legs straight and alternate small kicks.
exercises.safetyCues: Press your lower back firmly into the floor.

exercises.name: Forearm Plank
exercises.instructions: Hold a straight line from head to heels.
exercises.safetyCues: Keep your hips level, no sagging.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.instructions: Drive your knees up to waist height.
exercises.safetyCues: Modify: Drive one knee up at a time, keep other foot grounded

exercises.name: Jog
exercises.safetyCues: Modify: just step, always keep one foot on the ground

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.instructions: Standard jumping jacks, maintain a steady rhythm.
exercises.safetyCues: Modify: Step out, keep one foot in the center, no jump

exercises.name: Lateral High Knees
exercises.safetyCues: Modify: don't leave the ground, side step, drive knee up

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.instructions: In a plank position, drive knees to chest alternately.
exercises.safetyCues: Keep your shoulders directly over your wrists.

exercises.name: Oblique High Knee
exercises.safetyCues: Modification: Lift Knees, don't run

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.instructions: Keep your core tight and butt even with your back
exercises.safetyCues: Don't let your lower back sag.

exercises.name: Soccer Juggles
exercises.instructions: High Knee, Tap Cross Knee x 2, Tap Cross Ankle x 2
exercises.safetyCues: Modification: lift knee, tap, lift foot, tap, or tap calf

exercises.name: Squat Jacks
exercises.instructions: Low at center, High when Out
exercises.safetyCues: Modification: Step out instead of jump out

exercises.name: Squat Jumps
exercises.safetyCues: Modification: Lose the jump

exercises.name: Touch the Floor
exercises.safetyCues: Modify: step out, touch floor, center, step to the other side, touch...

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.instructions: Use a bench or chair, lower body until elbows are at 90 degrees.
exercises.safetyCues: Keep your back close to the bench.
